brief:
Three years after the October 7 attack, the assault remains central to Israeli political debate as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces mounting pressure over security failures. According to Al Jazeera English, the attack has reshaped the electoral landscape, with competing narratives about responsibility for the intelligence and defensive lapses that enabled the strike.

Netanyahu has sought to deflect accountability for the attack's consequences, even as it continues to define his political standing. The event has fractured Israeli consensus and fueled contentious blame between government factions, with the security failures serving as a focal point for challengers questioning his leadership and judgment.
dek: Three years on, October 7 is central to Israeli politics as Netanyahu faces pressure and deflects blame for his failures…
title: October 7 attack dominates Israeli elections as Netanyahu deflects blame
